mapper.select: select user_id, community_nickname, headline, bio, skills, github_url, website_url, contact_email, case when show_contact_email = '1' then 1 else 0 end as show_contact_email, update_time from qt_member_profile where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into qt_member_profile (user_id, community_nickname, headline, bio, skills, github_url, website_url, contact_email, show_contact_email, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{communityNickname}, #{headline}, #{bio}, #{skills}, #{githubUrl}, #{websiteUrl}, #{contactEmail}, if(#{showContactEmail}, '1', '0'), now()) on duplicate key update community_nickname = values(community_nickname), headline = values(headline), bio = values(bio), skills = values(skills), github_url = values(github_url), website_url = values(website_url), contact_email = values(contact_email), show_contact_email = values(show_contact_email), update_time = now()
